# FG-REPO-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unknown_ref_or_path_is_repository_path_not_resolved` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 指定したブランチ・タグ・コミット、またはファイルが見つかりません。名前とパスを確かめてください。
- en: The branch, tag, commit or file was not found. Check the name and the path.
- id: Branch, tag, commit, atau berkas tidak ditemukan. Periksa nama dan jalurnya.

## 原因 (cause)

A repository browse request (the API `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/repository/{refs,resolve,tree,blob}` or the content routes `{path}/-/raw/{ref}/{file}` / `{path}/-/archive/{ref}.{zip|tar.gz}`, M2 MR7, ADR-0015 Amendment M2) named something the repository does not have. Decided only after authorize() allowed (RepoBrowse / RepoRead), so it never tells a caller who may not read the project anything about it. `reason`: `ref_not_found` (no 40 / 64-hex commit id, no branch and no tag matches — ADR-0015 order: id, longest branch, longest tag; also an empty repository), `not_a_commit` (the id or the ref names a tree, blob or a tag of one), `path_not_found` (no such entry in that commit's tree), `not_a_tree` / `not_a_blob` (the entry is of the other kind; a submodule is neither), `archive_format` (the archive name does not end in `.zip` or `.tar.gz`), `path_remainder` (an archive name with more than a ref).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id`, `repo_id`, `route` and, once resolved, `commit`; never the requested ref or path (they are user input). Usually a typo, a deleted branch or a file that does not exist in that commit. To check by hand on the server: `git --git-dir <storage path of repo_id> for-each-ref refs/heads refs/tags` and `git ls-tree <commit> -- <path>`.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix on the server: correct the ref or the path (gstn browse refs lists the branches and tags). If an existing branch is reported missing right after a push, wait a few seconds (the ref list is cached for at most 5 s and dropped on every push).
